lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct white vertical lines traverse the torso. Spacing is relatively uniform across the midsection with a slight decrease in inter-line distance on the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 10th line segment (counted from anterior) at approximately the vertical midpoint of the torso mass.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 1 terminates prematurely near the upper shoulder; Line 11 is fragmented into three dashed segments; Line 12 terminates prior to reaching the ventral boundary of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 14 high-contrast white spots is localized on the lower haunch, with a higher density of 6 spots clustered near the mid-thigh region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A horizontal alignment of 4 spots forms a geometric line across the posterior-most section of the upper hind limb.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent white crescent-shaped mark is visible on the lower throat, and distinct white banding is observed on the lower limbs above the hooves.
